status.job.cancel.clone_tip: Stop {job} and remove what it has cloned so far.
status.job.cancel.local_tip: {job} is on a step that can't be stopped part-way. Wait for it to finish.
status.job.cancel.merging_tip: {job} is merging now and can't be cancelled: a merge stopped part-way would be left half-done.
status.job.cancel.push_tip: Stop {job}. The remote changes only once it has received the whole upload.
status.job.cancel.rebasing_tip: {job} is rebasing now and can't be cancelled: a rebase stopped part-way would be left half-done.
status.job.cancel.tip: Stop {job}. What it downloaded so far is discarded.
status.live.checking.label: Checking…
status.live.checking.tip: Checking that changes on disk show up live.
status.live.failed.label: Not watching
status.live.failed.tip_key: Glowfly can't watch this repository for changes. They show up when its window regains focus or you press {key}. Click to refresh now.
status.live.failed.tip_no_key: Glowfly can't watch this repository for changes. They show up when its window regains focus or you choose Refresh. Click to refresh now.
status.live.live.label: Live
status.live.live.tip: Live: changes to files show up as they happen.
status.live.silent.label: Slow updates
status.live.silent.tip: Changes on disk aren't arriving, so Glowfly re-reads the repository every {secs} seconds while its window is focused. Restarting Glowfly may fix this. Click to refresh now.
status.live.unknown.label: Unconfirmed
status.live.unknown.tip: Glowfly can't write to this repository, so it can't check that changes show up live.
